t: You're looking at the Church of St Mary the Virgin, an Anglican church right beside the Thames, at the southern end of Putney Bridge. Christian worship has taken place on this site since at least the 13th century, and the church is still active today. It's best known as the setting for the Putney Debates of 1647, on the English constitution, during the Civil War. The scholar and politician Robert Wood is buried here. He travelled the Levant in search of the sites mentioned by Homer. The clergyman Edward Henry Landon is also buried here.
